algorithm.description: The hashing algorithm used for OTP generation. Supported values: SHA1, SHA256, SHA512.

digits.description: The number of digits in the generated OTP code. Must be between 4 and 10.

period.description: The time period in seconds for TOTP generation. Must be between 10 and 120.

encrypted_storage.description: Whether to use AES256-GCM encrypted local database storage.

pbkdf2_iterations.description: The number of PBKDF2 iterations used to derive the encryption key.

backup_formats.description: List of supported backup import formats. Options: andOTP, Aegis, FreeOTPPlus, AuthenticatorPlus.
